info.title: PlasticWatch API
info.description: AI-GIS detection and prioritisation of likely plastic-waste hotspots. Reports show waste appears to be present; they do not establish who is responsible.

get.description: Seeded accounts for the login role picker (SPEC §9). No token required.

schema.title: Response List Demo Users Auth Demo Users Get

post.description: Pick a seeded user by id, or by role; returns a signed demo token.
P1: preview likely-plastic detection without saving a report.

Submit a photo report. Records that waste appears to be present — not who is
responsible (CLAUDE.md §2.3).

get.description: The caller's own reports and the status of each one's hotspot.

A citizen may read their own reports; an authority may read any. Another
citizen's report is a 404, so report ids can't be probed.
GeoJSON of hotspots, highest Impact first.

parameters.name: as_of

schema.description: Time slider: recompute scores from reports and events up to this time. Read-only — stored rows are never changed.
schema.title: As Of

parameters.description: Time slider: recompute scores from reports and events up to this time. Read-only — stored rows are never changed.

get.description: Score breakdown, member reports and the audit trail (the evidence ledger).
Ward boundaries with per-ward hotspot stats, for the choropleth.
All tasks for an authority; only its own for a team.

post.description: Optimised route over VERIFIED hotspots. Each hotspot becomes cleanup_scheduled.
Mark arrival — recorded only within ARRIVE_RADIUS_M (50 m) of the hotspot.

Two after-photos -> before/after record + SUGGESTED verdict (SPEC §14).

Moves the hotspot to cleanup_completed (the team's claim). Never resolves anything:
an authority reviews the photos side by side. Retakes are allowed until reviewed.

parameters.name: pending

schema.description: Only records awaiting an authority's review.
schema.title: Pending

parameters.description: Only records awaiting an authority's review.

schema.title: Response List Before After Before After Get

post.description: Authority inspects before/after side by side and confirms or rejects.

get.description: The 6 KPI cards plus band (open hotspots) and status breakdowns.
Reports, hotspots opened and hotspots resolved per UTC day.

post.description: Wipe and reseed the simulated 45-day demo history (takes ~20 s).

simulated_data.title: Simulated Data
simulated_data.description: True while the dashboard is showing seeded demo data (CLAUDE.md §2.2).

non_attribution_note.title: Non Attribution Note
non_attribution_note.default: Reports show waste appears to be present; they do not establish who is responsible.

non_attribution_note.title: Non Attribution Note
non_attribution_note.default: Reports show waste appears to be present; they do not establish who is responsible.

ArriveRequest.title: ArriveRequest
ArriveRequest.description: The team's current position, checked against the stop (SPEC §8: within 50 m).

ArriveResponse.title: ArriveResponse
ArriveResponse.description: Arrival is checked within 50 m of the stop (SPEC §8).

reduction_ratio.title: Reduction Ratio
reduction_ratio.description: 1 - (after plastic area / before plastic area), using the worse photo.

viewpoint_match.title: Viewpoint Match
viewpoint_match.description: ORB match score against the before image.

verdict_note.title: Verdict Note
verdict_note.default: A verdict is a suggestion. Only an authority can resolve a hotspot.

BeforeAfterRecord.title: BeforeAfterRecord
BeforeAfterRecord.description:
SPEC §14. The system computes a verdict but NEVER auto-resolves (CLAUDE.md §2.5).

Absence of detections after cleanup is not proof of cleanliness (CLAUDE.md §2.6).

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Omit lat/lon to use the photo's EXIF GPS.

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Team GPS at upload; else EXIF, else check-in.

ConfidenceTier.title: ConfidenceTier
ConfidenceTier.description:
Raw model confidence is not a calibrated probability (CLAUDE.md §2.7).

A tier is shown beside every number so a score is never read as a promise.

DemoLoginRequest.title: DemoLoginRequest
DemoLoginRequest.description: Pick a seeded user by id, or by role to take the first account with it.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Static 0.5 — learned reporter reliability is out of scope.

DemoUser.title: DemoUser
DemoUser.description: A seeded demo account. There is no real auth in this system (CLAUDE.md §8).

confidence_tier.description: Shown beside result.report_confidence; raw confidence is not calibrated.

is_simulated.title: Is Simulated
is_simulated.description: True while the detector runs in stub mode (fabricated output).

DetectPreview.title: DetectPreview
DetectPreview.description:
POST /detect — the frozen DetectorOutput, wrapped with the tier the UI must show.

Composition, not inheritance: `result` is exactly what detector.py returns, so
the §6 contract appears verbatim (as its own schema) in /docs, and the tier is
added at the API layer without touching it (CLAUDE.md §2.7).

Detection.title: Detection
Detection.description: One detected litter item. Box coordinates are pixels in the source image.

DetectionClass.title: DetectionClass
DetectionClass.description:
SPEC §6 — 5 classes collapsed from TACO's 60.

The four plastic_* classes are "plastic-likely". No person, vehicle or
licence-plate class may ever be added here (CLAUDE.md §2.4).

plastic_area_frac.title: Plastic Area Frac
plastic_area_frac.description: Sum of likely-plastic box areas / image area, capped at 1.0.

report_confidence.title: Report Confidence
report_confidence.description: Mean of the top-3 plastic-likely confidences.

annotated_jpg_path.title: Annotated Jpg Path
annotated_jpg_path.description: Always present; null when no annotated image was written.

DetectorOutput.title: DetectorOutput
DetectorOutput.description:
FROZEN CONTRACT (SPEC §6) — detector.py returns exactly this shape in both
stub and real mode. Do not add, rename or reorder fields without a stage.

EvidenceBand.title: EvidenceBand
EvidenceBand.description: SPEC §11 Evidence bands (half-open): <0.4 low, [0.4,0.75) moderate, >=0.75 strong.

GeoContext.title: GeoContext
GeoContext.description: Distances stored on the hotspot row at create/update (SPEC §10).

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: Any GeoJSON geometry: drains are lines, water polygons, amenities points.

before_after.description: Latest before/after record for this hotspot (SPEC §14), if any.

non_attribution_note.title: Non Attribution Note
non_attribution_note.description: Persistent note required on authority views.
non_attribution_note.default: Reports show waste appears to be present; they do not establish who is responsible.

HotspotDetail.title: HotspotDetail
HotspotDetail.description: GET /hotspots/{id} — score breakdown, reports, events (the evidence ledger).

HotspotEvent.title: HotspotEvent
HotspotEvent.description: Audit log row. actor_id is the human who acted, null for system transitions.

is_simulated.title: Is Simulated
is_simulated.description: True when any member report has a fabricated geotag (CLAUDE.md §2.2).

HotspotProperties.title: HotspotProperties
HotspotProperties.description: FROZEN — the property set every map marker styles itself from.

HotspotStatus.title: HotspotStatus
HotspotStatus.description: SPEC §13. Only an authority reaches verified / false_positive / resolved.

HotspotSummary.title: HotspotSummary
HotspotSummary.description: The hotspot a report landed on, as returned to the citizen who reported it.

KpiCards.title: KpiCards
KpiCards.description: The 6 KPI cards of SPEC §2 F8.

LocationSource.title: LocationSource
LocationSource.description: SPEC §7 reports.location_source. Capture order: browser GPS -> EXIF -> map pin.

PriorityBand.title: PriorityBand
PriorityBand.description: SPEC §11 Impact bands (half-open): >=70 critical, [50,70) high, [30,50) medium, <30 low.

merged.title: Merged
merged.description: True when the report joined an existing hotspot rather than creating one.

low_accuracy.title: Low Accuracy
low_accuracy.description: Location accuracy was low; the merge radius was widened.

message.title: Message
message.description: Plain-language outcome for the citizen, e.g. no likely plastic found.

ReportCreateResponse.title: ReportCreateResponse
ReportCreateResponse.description: Result of POST /reports: detect -> dedupe -> context -> score (SPEC §8).

low_accuracy.title: Low Accuracy
low_accuracy.description: GPS accuracy was poor enough to widen the merge radius.

hotspot_status.description: Pending / work in progress / completed, as shown to the citizen.

is_duplicate.title: Is Duplicate
is_duplicate.description: Matched an existing image; attached as evidence but not counted twice.

low_accuracy.title: Low Accuracy
low_accuracy.description: GPS accuracy was poor enough to widen the merge radius.

hotspot_status.description: Pending / work in progress / completed, as shown to the citizen.

is_duplicate.title: Is Duplicate
is_duplicate.description: Matched an existing image; attached as evidence but not counted twice.

ReportSummary.title: ReportSummary
ReportSummary.description: A citizen's own report and the status of the hotspot it belongs to.

message.title: Message
message.default: Demo state reseeded. All geotags in this dataset are simulated.

ResetDemoResponse.title: ResetDemoResponse
ResetDemoResponse.description: POST /admin/reset-demo — wipes and reseeds the simulated demo state.

ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision
ReviewDecision.description: SPEC §8 POST /before-after/{id}/review. Only confirm_resolved closes a hotspot.

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description: A human authority action. Only confirm_resolved closes the hotspot.

evidence_label.title: Evidence Label
evidence_label.description: e.g. "human-verified" once an authority has confirmed.

weights_note.title: Weights Note
weights_note.default: Weights are tunable proposals, not published truth.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: Impact ranks the hotspot; Evidence governs what may be claimed.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: Impact axis: points out of 100. Evidence axis: share of 0-1.

ScoreFactor.title: ScoreFactor
ScoreFactor.description:
One row of the explanation card (SPEC §11).

Weights are tunable proposals documented here, not published truth (CLAUDE.md §2.8).

depot.title: Depot
depot.description: [lon, lat] start/end point of the route.

TaskCreateRequest.title: TaskCreateRequest
TaskCreateRequest.description: Tasks accept VERIFIED hotspots only (SPEC §13) — a non-verified id is a 409.

route_geojson.title: Route Geojson
route_geojson.description: Decoded ORS geometry, or straight lines when the fallback ran.

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: SPEC §14. A verdict is a suggestion — it never resolves anything by itself.

reason.description: Required when decision is reject or false_positive.

VerifyRequest.title: VerifyRequest
VerifyRequest.description: SPEC §8. A human authority action — nothing here happens automatically.
